title: Heading of the popover with the connection's details. "Socio" is the product name.
status: Row label; the value is Online, Reconnecting or Offline.
round-trip: Row label; the value is the time a request took to the server and back.
not-measured: Value of the Round trip row in the connection details popover before any round trip was timed.
latency-quality: {{latency}} is like "120 ms"; {{quality}} is good, fair or slow.
recent: Row label; the value lists the last few round-trip times.
recent-list: {{latencies}} is a list of times like "120 ms", formatted as a list.
last-check: Row label; the value is a time of day.
not-yet: Value of Last check before the first check.
last-disconnect: Row label; the value is a time of day.
no-disconnect: Value of Last disconnect when the connection never dropped since the tab was opened.
quality.good: How fast the last round trip to the server was, lowercase, after the time ("120 ms, good").
quality.fair: How fast the last round trip to the server was, lowercase, after the time ("350 ms, fair").
quality.slow: How fast the last round trip to the server was, lowercase, after the time ("900 ms, slow").
label-measured: The same once a round trip was measured: {{latency}} is like "120 ms", {{quality}} good, fair or slow.
